name: Garden Grove Teen Action Collaborative (GGTAC)
org: City of Garden Grove Community Services Department
what_you_do: Join a teen leadership group. You do service projects, volunteer at city events and go to career workshops. You can also apply for scholarships.
who_can_apply: Teens who are 13 to 17 years old by November 19, 2026. The page calls it a program by and for Garden Grove teens. A parent or guardian must sign the forms.
pay_detail: Unpaid. No fee is listed on the program page. Members can apply for scholarships.
duration: September 2026 to April 2027, one meeting a month
deadline_text: Applications are accepted September 1 through November 19, 2026. Meetings are the 3rd Thursday of each month, 4:00 to 5:00 p.m.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application and the contract. A parent or guardian signs them. You can email them to ggtac@ggcity.org. You can also drop them off at City Hall, 11222 Acacia Parkway. Or bring them to the next general meeting.
notes: Members must go to the monthly meetings and join at least 2 volunteer events. Meetings are at the Community Meeting Center, 11300 Stanford Avenue, and food is provided. Planned events include Foods of Garden Grove Live, Jack O Lantern Jamboree and Winter in the Grove. To win a scholarship you must go to at least 4 meetings and volunteer at 2 GGTAC events. Questions: 714-741-5360.
